actions: Start on the shipped product's Stock tab with physical stock at 15 after a closed shipment sent five units from its warehouse in decrease-on-close mode.
Open Full list and scroll right to see the stock movements and their Origin links.
Follow that shipment's Origin link and wait for the processed shipment to load.
Click Delete and inspect the confirmation dialog.
Keep stock restoration unselected (clear the choice if it is initially selected), then click Yes.
Wait for the shipment overview, open Products | Services, follow the same product from the recent stock movements, and open Stock.
Open Full list and scroll right to inspect the movement history.
